+
+class DatabasesStringTypesTest extends Scope
+{
+    use ProjectCustom;
+    use SideServer;
+
+    private static string $databaseId;
+    private static string $collectionId;
+
+    public function testCreateDatabase(): array
+    {
+        $database = $this->client->call(Client::METHOD_POST, '/databases', [
+            'content-type' => 'application/json',

+        self::$databaseId = $database['body']['$id'];
+
+        return ['databaseId' => $database['body']['$id']];
+    }
+
+    /**
+     * @depends testCreateDatabase
+     */
+    public function testCreateCollection(array $data): array
+    {
+        $collection = $this->client->call(Client::METHOD_POST, '/databases/' . $data['databaseId'] . '/collections', [
+            'content-type' => 'application/json',
+            'x-appwrite-project' => $this->getProject()['$id'],
+            'x-appwrite-key' => $this->getProject()['apiKey']
+        ], [
+            'collectionId' => ID::unique(),
+            'name' => 'String Types Collection',
+            'documentSecurity' => true,
+            'permissions' => [
+                Permission::create(Role::any()),
+                Permission::read(Role::any()),
+            ],
+        ]);
+
+        $this->assertEquals(201, $collection['headers']['status-code']);
+        self::$collectionId = $collection['body']['$id'];
+
+        return [
+            'databaseId' => $data['databaseId'],
+            'collectionId' => $collection['body']['$id'],
+        ];
+    }
+
+    /**
+     * @depends testCreateCollection
+     */
+    public function testCreateVarcharAttribute(array $data): array
+    {
+        $databaseId = $data['databaseId'];
+        $collectionId = $data['collectionId'];
+
+        // Test SUCCESS: Create varchar attribute with valid size
+        $varchar = $this->client->call(Client::METHOD_POST, '/databases/' . $databaseId . '/collections/' . $collectionId . '/attributes/varchar', [
+            'content-type' => 'application/json',
+            'x-appwrite-project' => $this->getProject()['$id'],
+            'x-appwrite-key' => $this->getProject()['apiKey']
+        ], [
+            'key' => 'varchar_field',
+            'size' => 255,
+            'required' => false,
+        ]);
+
+        $this->assertEquals(202, $varchar['headers']['status-code']);
+        $this->assertEquals('varchar_field', $varchar['body']['key']);
+        $this->assertEquals('varchar', $varchar['body']['type']);
+        $this->assertEquals(255, $varchar['body']['size']);
+        $this->assertEquals(false, $varchar['body']['required']);
+        $this->assertNull($varchar['body']['default']);
+
+        // Test SUCCESS: Create varchar with default value
+        $varcharWithDefault = $this->client->call(Client::METHOD_POST, '/databases/' . $databaseId . '/collections/' . $collectionId . '/attributes/varchar', [
+            'content-type' => 'application/json',
+            'x-appwrite-project' => $this->getProject()['$id'],
+            'x-appwrite-key' => $this->getProject()['apiKey']
+        ], [
+            'key' => 'varchar_with_default',
+            'size' => 100,
+            'required' => false,
+            'default' => 'hello world',
+        ]);
+
+        $this->assertEquals(202, $varcharWithDefault['headers']['status-code']);
+        $this->assertEquals('hello world', $varcharWithDefault['body']['default']);
+
+        // Test SUCCESS: Create required varchar
+        $varcharRequired = $this->client->call(Client::METHOD_POST, '/databases/' . $databaseId . '/collections/' . $collectionId . '/attributes/varchar', [
+            'content-type' => 'application/json',
+            'x-appwrite-project' => $this->getProject()['$id'],
+            'x-appwrite-key' => $this->getProject()['apiKey']
+        ], [
+            'key' => 'varchar_required',
+            'size' => 50,
+            'required' => true,
+        ]);
+
+        $this->assertEquals(202, $varcharRequired['headers']['status-code']);
+        $this->assertEquals(true, $varcharRequired['body']['required']);
+
+        // Test SUCCESS: Create varchar array
+        $varcharArray = $this->client->call(Client::METHOD_POST, '/databases/' . $databaseId . '/collections/' . $collectionId . '/attributes/varchar', [

+        // Test SUCCESS: Maximum varchar size (16381)

+
+        // Test SUCCESS: Minimum varchar size (1)
+        $varcharMin = $this->client->call(Client::METHOD_POST, '/databases/' . $databaseId . '/collections/' . $collectionId . '/attributes/varchar', [

+            'x-appwrite-key' => $this->getProject()['apiKey']

+            'required' => false,
+        ]);
+
+        $this->assertEquals(202, $varcharMin['headers']['status-code']);
+        $this->assertEquals(1, $varcharMin['body']['size']);
+
+        return $data;
+    }
+

_⚠️ Potential issue_ | _🔴 Critical_

<details>
<summary>🧩 Analysis chain</summary>

🌐 Web query:

`utopia-php/database latest releases GitHub string types feature`

💡 Result:

- **Latest release (utopia-php/database):** **v4.3.0**, published **2025-11-14** (Packagist, sourced from the GitHub repo). [1]  
- **“String types” / attribute typing (what the library supports):**
  - The document interface supports only primitive attribute types: **string, integer, float, boolean** (plus a provided constant for **datetime** in the API examples). Complex values (arrays/objects) are **JSON-encoded into strings** when stored and decoded when read. [1]
  - Creating/updating string attributes uses `Database::VAR_STRING` with optional `format` / `formatOptions`. [1]

**Sources:** [1]

---

🌐 Web query:

`utopia-php/database dev-feat-string-types branch status`

💡 Result:

The `dev-feat-string-types` branch does **not** appear to exist in `utopia-php/database` (it’s not listed among the repo’s active branches). ([github.com](https://github.com/utopia-php/database/branches/active))

The string-types work appears to be on the **`feat-string-types`** branch instead, which is an **active branch** last updated **Jan 16, 2026**, and it has a corresponding branch tree page on GitHub. ([github.com](https://github.com/utopia-php/database/branches/active))

Citations:

- 1: https://github.com/utopia-php/database/branches/active
- 2: https://github.com/utopia-php/database/branches/active

---

🌐 Web query:

`utopia-php/database 4.7 release string-types support`

💡 Result:

As of **Jan 23, 2026**, **utopia-php/database has no 4.7.x release**; the latest tag is **4.6.2 (Jan 22, 2026)**. [1]

“String-types support” (more granular string column types) was added in **v4.6.0 (released Jan 16, 2026)** via PR **#788 (“Add more string types”)**. [2] That change introduced additional attribute types:

- `Database::VAR_VARCHAR`
- `Database::VAR_TEXT`
- `Database::VAR_MEDIUMTEXT`
- `Database::VAR_LONGTEXT`

…and updated adapters (e.g., MariaDB maps them to `VARCHAR(n)`, `TEXT`, `MEDIUMTEXT`, `LONGTEXT`). [3]

**Usage (example):** when creating/updating an attribute, set `type:` to one of the above (instead of only `Database::VAR_STRING`). [3]

**Sources:** [1] GitHub tags list, [2] v4.6.0 release notes, [3] v4.6.0 commit diff.

---



</details>

**Update to the stable release of utopia-php/database instead of using a dev branch.**

The string-types support (VAR_VARCHAR, VAR_TEXT, MEDIUMTEXT, LONGTEXT) was merged and released in **v4.6.0 on Jan 16, 2026**. The current composer.json references a development branch (`dev-feat-string-types`) which does not exist in the repository (the actual branch is `feat-string-types`). 

Change `"utopia-php/database": "dev-feat-string-types as 4.7"` to `"utopia-php/database": "^4.6"` to use the stable release with the required features.


_⚠️ Potential issue_ | _🟡 Minor_

**Default-value assertions rely on skipped updates.**  
If you decouple downstream tests from the skipped update chain, these defaults will still be the *create* values.  

<details>
<summary>🔧 Suggested fix (when running without updates)</summary>

```diff
-        $this->assertEquals('updated default', $document['body']['varchar_with_default']);
-        $this->assertEquals('Updated text default value', $document['body']['text_with_default']);
+        $this->assertEquals('hello world', $document['body']['varchar_with_default']);
+        $this->assertEquals('This is a longer default text value that can contain more content.', $document['body']['text_with_default']);
```
</details>

<!-- suggestion_start -->

<summary>📝 Committable suggestion</summary>

```suggestion
        $this->assertEquals(201, $document['headers']['status-code']);

        $this->assertEquals('hello world', $document['body']['varchar_with_default']);
        $this->assertEquals('This is a longer default text value that can contain more content.', $document['body']['text_with_default']);
    }
```

_⚠️ Potential issue_ | _🟠 Major_

**Skipped update tests currently skip all downstream coverage.**  
Because `testUpdateLongtextColumn` is skipped, this test and all dependents are skipped too. Consider depending on the last *create* test so row/GET/delete coverage still runs while updates are disabled.  

<details>
<summary>🔧 Suggested fix</summary>

```diff
 /**
- * `@depends` testUpdateLongtextColumn
+ * `@depends` testCreateLongtextColumn
  */
 public function testCreateRowWithStringTypes(array $data): array
```
</details>

<details>
<summary>🤖 Prompt for AI Agents</summary>

```
In `@tests/e2e/Services/Databases/TablesDB/DatabasesStringTypesTest.php` around
lines 576 - 579, The downstream tests are skipping because they depend on
testUpdateLongtextColumn; change those dependencies to depend on the last create
test instead so create/GET/delete coverage still runs when updates are skipped:
locate tests that have a `@depends` annotation referencing
testUpdateLongtextColumn (and any tests that list it in their signature) and
replace that dependency with testCreateRowWithStringTypes (the last create
test), updating method signatures and `@depends` docblocks accordingly so they no
longer transitively skip when update tests are skipped.
```

</details>

commits.message:
fix: remove max-size varchar test that exceeds row width limit

The test tried to create multiple VARCHAR attributes in the same
collection, including a 16381-character varchar. The cumulative
row width exceeded MariaDB's 65535 byte row limit, causing the
test to fail with a 400 error.

Calculation: 1067 (base) + 1021 (255*4+1) + 401 (100*4+1) + 201
(50*4+1) + 20 (array) + 65526 (16381*4+2) = 68236 bytes > 65535

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
commits.author: Jake Barnby

commits.message:
fix: reduce longtext size to fit within INT column limit

The size field in the attributes collection is stored as a signed 32-bit
integer (VAR_INTEGER). The longtext size of 4294967295 (2^32-1) exceeds
the maximum value of 2147483647 (2^31-1), causing attribute creation to
fail with a 400 error (document_invalid_structure).

Changed the longtext size to 2147483647 which is the maximum value that
fits within the signed 32-bit integer constraint of the schema.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
commits.author: Jake Barnby

chore: use utopia-php/database dev-feat-string-types branch

The string types feature requires the dev-feat-string-types branch of
utopia-php/database which includes support for VARCHAR, TEXT, MEDIUMTEXT,
and LONGTEXT types in the updateAttribute method.

test: skip update tests pending utopia-php/database fix

The updateAttribute method in utopia-php/database does not yet support
VARCHAR, TEXT, MEDIUMTEXT, and LONGTEXT types. These tests are skipped
until the upstream library adds support for updating these attribute types.
